acc-completeness.name: ACC Completeness
acc-completeness.description: List missing pages, sketches, neighbor notes, and unsigned fields on the architectural application they use, against their form or guidelines.

bid-compare.name: Bid Compare
bid-compare.description: Compare amounts, allowances, exclusions, and dates from bid PDFs they provided for one project.

board-files.name: Board Files
board-files.description: Assemble a present-or-missing list of files for the next meeting they name: agenda, last approved minutes, financials they already produced, and exhibits they listed.

dues-aging.name: Dues Aging
dues-aging.description: List balances by current, thirty, sixty, and ninety-plus from their ledger export after you confirm community name and as-of date.

election-tally.name: Election Tally
election-tally.description: Count from the roster and ballot or proxy files they provide. Label the product a tally, not a certified election.

reserve-index.name: Reserve Index
reserve-index.description: Confirm the reserve-study PDF is present, copy the report date and association name on the cover, and copy any printed number they asked for.

vendor-certs.name: Vendor Certs
vendor-certs.description: List expiration dates, named insured, and additional-insured wording as printed from certificates they filed.

violations.name: Violations
violations.description: From their log or export, list open items, lots, categories they use, status against their adopted notice steps, and missing photos or blank lots.

work-orders.name: Work Orders
work-orders.description: From their export, list open common-area jobs, locations, vendors, and missing vendor or photo fields.
